precheck.description: Check retire-catalog-preferences has work to do
precheck.sql:
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT "researcherAccountId" AS "researcherAccountId" FROM "public"."modelConfiguration" WHERE jsonb_typeof("document" #> '{extractionSettings,catalog}') = 'object'
            AND ("document" #> '{extractionSettings,catalog}') ?| array['generic','recipe'] LIMIT 1) AS ok

execute.sql:
UPDATE "public"."modelConfiguration" SET "document" = jsonb_set("document", '{extractionSettings,catalog}',
            ("document" #> '{extractionSettings,catalog}') - 'generic' - 'recipe') WHERE jsonb_typeof("document" #> '{extractionSettings,catalog}') = 'object'
            AND ("document" #> '{extractionSettings,catalog}') ?| array['generic','recipe']

postcheck.sql:
